title: Holding the Dirty Thing by the Clean Side

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The chapter on emotional legitimacy turns the inquiry toward everyday psychological competence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Recognizing emotion can help people face conflict without destroying their relationships.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same competence can be used to make objections quieter without addressing their cause.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book distinguishes facing difficult truth from elegantly avoiding its moral pressure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An organization may praise resilience while leaving the underlying source of exhaustion untouched.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The affected person is then asked to improve how they absorb the burden.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This distinction connects emotional intelligence to voice, responsibility, and practical possibilities for change.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The chapter offers more than a blanket dismissal of empathy or emotional skill.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Artificial intelligence enters an institutional history that already knows how to conceal costs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It can accelerate decisions, generate explanations, and make complex procedures appear impersonal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks whether automation reduces degrading work or simply reorganizes who carries it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A fluent explanation cannot by itself make the underlying decision legitimate.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Affected people still need ways to understand, contest, and correct consequential judgments.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The author also sees opportunities to expose burdens previously difficult to trace.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: AI can therefore sharpen both the danger and the practical demand for accountability.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is a social argument about authority, rather than a forecast about one particular model.
